source.host: results.beijing2008.cn (BOCOG official results site), read as Wayback Machine HTTPS copies (https://web.archive.org); approved for Beijing_2008_OG only (maintainer 2026-10-19d, legacy skill)

documents.use: competition schedule (final, after the 14 Aug storm postponement); dates cross-checked

source.not_used: 2008-Beijing-Slalom-Results.pdf (startlists_2026-11-04.zip, slalom/Olympic_Games): Official Results book; its text layer is in a shifted font and it prints results only, no start times; not needed

identification: Gallery "Canoe-Slalom-Beijing-2008" (428 photos) = Games of the XXIX Olympiad, canoe/kayak slalom, Shunyi Olympic Rowing-Canoeing Park, 11–15 Aug 2008 (maintainer t162u names it the 2008 Olympic Games)
start_time_note: Every time is the per-boat Start Time printed on the official start lists (heats: 1st run and 2nd run columns; semifinals and finals: one column). No listed source prints actual start times, so start_times=scheduled and there is no scheduled_times gap. Forerunners F1–F3 carry their printed times.

actual_starts.note: no listed source prints actual starts

storm_note: Heavy rain on 14 Aug moved K1 women semifinal/final and C2 men final to Fri 15 Aug; every start list used is the version printed after that change (dates match the final schedule page).
rank_source: official Result List "Semifinal and Final" (C73B) per class: the event classification (semifinal + final total), as printed
